articles.title: Halo Circle Pearl
articles.summary: Even field of soft round dots, each ringed by a faint luminous pearl halo, glowing gently on a semi-matte surface. Reads as your colour with a fine polka-dot shimmer of pale pearl dots; far off it becomes a soft frosty sheen.
articles.what: Circle pattern with soft pearl halos ringing each dot — luminous bubble array on surface Up close: Evenly scattered small rings, each about 8-10 px with a bright white-pearl rim and a soft glow, spaced 22-28 px apart and slightly jittered. The ground between rings is plain flat grey with faint fine speckle. From a distance: Reads as your colour with a fine polka-dot shimmer of pale pearl dots; far off it becomes a soft frosty sheen. Measured spec (average): metal 48, roughness 155, coat 54. Shine: semi-matte. Metal: low. It takes the colour you give the zone.
when: Fits: gt / sports car, show car, stock car.
how: Click the zone you want to change.
Click the BASE MATERIAL box (it says "Click to choose a base") and type "Halo Circle Pearl" in the SEARCH FINISHES box.
Click it to open the big preview, then click Apply.
Pick your colour with BASE COLOR.
Render and judge it on the car, not on the swatch.
tips: Hood, roof, doors: the dot field reads on broad flats
Whole body for an even glow
Dots are small and sparse; numbers read clearly in any colour, just keep a decent contrast to the base colour.
A bold stripe or number plate: paint is plain around the dots, so graphics stay clean
Pairs well with: deep navy, soft pink, chrome trim.
pitfalls: Not a printed dot colour pattern: the grey in the preview is a neutral input, the finish takes your colour
Not a metallic flake: dots are rings with pearl glow, no spread sparkle
Avoid: busy graphics over the dots, very matte clearcoat kills the halo.
articles.spec_character: Average spec: metal 48 (low metal, like carbon or subtle flake), roughness 155 (semi-matte), clearcoat 54 (strong-to-medium clearcoat). The spec is textured, not flat: metal and roughness and clearcoat vary by 20 or more across the surface.
articles.intent_note: Full-finish shelf: the finish carries both its own paint look and its own shine.
articles.paint_advice: Gloss shows the paint colour as it is, so any colour works; pick the colour for contrast with the neighbouring zones, not for the finish. Avoid: busy graphics over the dots, very matte clearcoat kills the halo.

combos.why: Patterns that suit it: a bold stripe or number plate: paint is plain around the dots, so graphics stay clean; large solid graphics or gradients: the dots ride on top of any colour
Patterns to avoid: other dot, polka or perforation patterns: they moire against the halo rings; fine grain: lost in the ring texture
Spec overlays that work: none: the pearl ring spec is the effect
Judge the paint and the shine together: the same spec looks different under different colours.
